title: bsq2_dp~
description: `bsq2_dp~` is a double-precision second-order band-stop filter with signal input and output and a Q control inlet. Its arguments set the center frequency in Hz, Q, and interpolation time in milliseconds; for example, `bsq2_dp~ 440 1 200` uses 440 Hz, Q 1, and 200 ms interpolation.
